tonight.headline: Jefferson is out, and McLaurin tweaked a hamstring in London
body: Bad news first, twice. Justin Jefferson is ruled out after three missed practices; you already moved Jordan Addison into his slot at 12:34 today, and ESPN has re-projected Addison from 11.6 to 14.8. Then, this afternoon, Terry McLaurin, your flex, came out of Friday's practice in London with a hamstring issue and is questionable. He locks first, at 07:30 Sunday. ESPN has it 124.7 to Aye-Aye's 125.0, 50%.

One thing to do, and it's on Sunday at 06:00: check Washington's inactives. If McLaurin is out, Jalen Coker goes into the flex; Coker is questionable himself, and Alvin Kamara, who plays Monday, covers him. D'Andre Swift practised in full and carries no designation, so the Monangai card is finished.

case.label: The risk
case.body: McLaurin's 13.1 is now the number most likely to be wrong. The hamstring appeared on Friday, he was limited, and no report says how bad it is (ProFootballTalk; Pelissero via Yahoo, 2 Oct). PFT's own line: injuries that pop up late in the week often lead to absences. A receiver who is active on a fresh hamstring can also play a reduced game, and no inactive list will show that.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Aye-Aye start Herbert (12.6), McCaffrey (20.3), Jeremiyah Love (15.6), Kyren Williams in the flex (13.1), St. Brown (20.2), McMillan (15.0), Tyler Warren (13.1) and the Eagles D/ST. Herbert isn't on the Chargers' final report and St. Brown isn't on Detroit's (Chargers.com; DetroitLions.com 2 Oct). Aaron Jones (18.1) sits on their bench behind Kyren Williams. None of them has played.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: McLaurin inactive at 06:00 Sunday: Coker into the flex. Coker inactive at 16:50 Sunday: Kamara into the flex. Both active: the lineup stands as set.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · check inactives Sun 06:00 Mexico City; the flex locks at 07:30 (London)
doFirst.title: If McLaurin is inactive: Coker into the flex, Kamara behind him
doFirst.subtitle: New this afternoon: a Friday hamstring, questionable. Don't move today; the replacement is hurt too.

case.label: The injury
case.body: McLaurin was added to Washington's report on Friday with a hamstring, limited, and is questionable for the Colts in London (ProFootballTalk; Pelissero via Yahoo; NFL.com status list, 2 Oct). Nothing on severity and no quote from Quinn that I could find. It broke after his number was set: ESPN flags him questionable and still projects 13.1, a tenth above this morning. Not priced.

case.label: Why not swap now
case.body: The alternative is Coker at 13.0, a tenth lower, and he's questionable with a quad: a full individual period and limited team snaps on Friday, and Canales said 'We're going to have to see tomorrow... to see where that's headed' (Panthers.com 2 Oct). Swapping one hurt receiver for another on a coin flip isn't an edge, so the projection stands until the inactive list says otherwise.

case.label: The order
case.body: McLaurin's inactives come at 06:00 Sunday, 90 minutes before the 07:30 kickoff. If he's out, start Coker: he plays Sunday night, so his own inactives arrive at 16:50, and if he's out too Kamara (10.6, Monday 18:15) is still unlocked for the flex. Putting Kamara in first would waste that order.

case.label: Who is throwing
case.body: Marcus Mariota. Jayden Daniels (left elbow) is ruled out (NFL.com; Yahoo 2 Oct). Mariota was 19 of 31 for 183 and three touchdowns last week, and McLaurin drew 9 of the 22 targets (archive). Coker has Bryce Young, who isn't on Carolina's report.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: It fires and the player you put in the flex scores less than the best bench back or receiver left unlocked at the time.

whatWentWrong.title: The flex was a coin flip between two healthy receivers on Wednesday; now both are hurt
whatWentWrong.lead: McLaurin 13.1, questionable (hamstring, Friday). Coker 13.0, questionable (quad, limited all week).

case.label: The evidence
case.body: McLaurin: added Friday, limited (ProFootballTalk 2 Oct). Coker: DNP Wednesday, limited Thursday, limited Friday; Canales won't decide before Saturday (Panthers.com 2 Oct). With Jefferson out, the receivers behind them are gone: the next flex option is a running back.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The card above. It also makes Sunday 06:00 the one check that matters this week, which is earlier than any brief you'll get that day.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Saturday's travel and practice notes from London. Tomorrow afternoon's run reads them; a downgrade to doubtful or out moves Coker in a day early.

whatWentWrong.title: Jefferson's 18.7 sat unpriced through three missed practices
whatWentWrong.lead: The Addison cover was written Wednesday and you fired it today, before the designation. ESPN followed: 18.7 to 0.0, and Addison 11.6 to 14.8.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: DNP Wednesday, Thursday and Friday; ruled out (Vikings.com 2 Oct, 13:30 CT). O'Connell calls him day-to-day and says 'we will not rush Jefferson back before he's at a certain place where we feel like he can go be himself'.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Addison now starts on the projection, not on an override. It also leaves the flex with no healthy receiver behind it, which is why McLaurin's hamstring matters more than it would have on Wednesday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing this week. Next week's practice reports decide whether this is one game or several.

worthALook.name: DK Metcalf
worthALook.lead: 88% rostered everywhere else and unowned here. He can't be added before Wednesday, so this is Tuesday's decision.

case.label: The role

case.label: The number that kills it today
case.body: He has already played Week 4 and is locked on waivers until Wed 7 Oct, 01:00 Mexico City. ESPN projected him 10.1 this week, and the waiver tool, on Weeks 1–3, says nothing clears this roster's bar.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday's run, before claims process. Chem's priority resets weekly, so the claim costs nothing lasting. Friday settled the drop: Jefferson is out, so Addison has a role, and Swift is cleared, so Monangai is a ten-carry backup and the sixth back. The drop would be Monangai.
